global_rules.red_buttons: Preserve SCRUM-273 assets under assets/sprites/ui/frames/red_gold/ unchanged.
global_rules.content_rule: Runtime content, text, icons, portraits, controls and hit areas must remain inside declared content_rect only; border/gem/brass rail zones are forbidden.
global_rules.style: Minimal dark fantasy: obsidian/graphite fills, thin aged-brass outline, tiny ruby pins only; no heavy ornament or dragon curls.

ui_frame_minimal_modal.role: Large window/modal frame for main menu panels, settings/codex/pause/result screens.
ui_frame_minimal_modal.safe_zone_policy: Content only inside content_rect_xywh; thin brass/ruby outline and all bevel pixels are forbidden zones.
ui_frame_minimal_modal.suggested_runtime: StyleBoxTexture / NinePatchRect with tile stretch for center where aspect may change; whole-image proportional only for authored screen-specific layouts.
